items.title: Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur
items.text: Chandel district urges reporting of adulterated liquor after 11 deaths; advisory warns against suspicious alcohol and to seek medical help.

items.title: Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026
items.text: While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output. On the other hand, fuel-related sectors contracted again

items.title: Pakistan Army chief Munir vows to eliminate terrorism from country
items.text: Pakistan overall witnessed a significant decline in terrorism-related violence during October, with attacks falling by 37%, deaths resulting from these attacks declining by 57%, and injuries decreasing by 71% compared to September, said Dawn newspaper report

items.title: IRDAI imposes ₹2 cr penalty on Star Health
items.text: The insurer is advised to ensure all policies are serviced as per the terms and conditions of the policy documents and no arbitrary deductions/denial are made to the claim without proper justification, IRDAI said.

items.title: Bangladesh hit by fresh arson attacks in political unrest
items.text: Police said 124 people linked to the Awami League had been arrested in the capital Dhaka over the past 24 hours, without providing further details
